annotations.title: Compare 2-5 Wildberries products: prices, cheapest, price spread, stock

description:
Compare 2-5 Wildberries products: prices, cheapest, price spread, stock. Fetches 2-5 product URLs (urls=comma-separated, or repeated url=) with the same live chain as /product/info and returns per-item title/price/original_price/in_stock/rating/reviews_count, the cheapest and most expensive item, price_diff (abs RUB and percent of the cheapest), in_stock_count and all_in_stock. Items that fail carry error/detail; returns 502 (payment not settled) only if fewer than 2 items returned a price.

GET /product/compare — price $0.006 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

urls.description: 2-5 comma-separated product URLs (Wildberries; Ozon is accepted but currently blocked by its anti-bot). Alternatively repeat url= instead.
